score.rule: one output per input occurrence with numeric score >= 0.7; preserve its id and input order
score.multiplicity: one per eligible input occurrence; duplicates remain duplicates
score.membershipDomain: all input id values, including ineligible records
score.attribution: our independent synthetic acceptance contract; no external owner authorization

silent.rule: one output per numeric score >= 0.7, independent of source label; preserve id, duplicates and order
silent.sourceRole: diagnostic label declared by this synthetic contract
silent.attribution: our synthetic reconstruction; source-is-diagnostic is our new declaration, not a real user authorization

holdout.rule: lowercase valid email; same mailbox ignores case and +tags; first row wins; preserve first-appearance order and its canonical Full Name
holdout.multiplicity: one output per mailbox equivalence class
holdout.membershipDomain: lowercased Email values from all input rows, before mailbox deduplication
holdout.fixtureScope: valid business emails at a fixed canary.example.org domain; simple already-canonical ASCII names; no titles, padding, Anna, Gmail, lookup or sorting
holdout.attribution: original Relaybrook README business semantics; our new synthetic input family, not owner adoption or a new bug discovery

whitelist.rule: numeric score >= 0.7 AND id in the frozen literal whitelist; preserve id, duplicates and input order
whitelist.scopeReason: literal identity values participate in the business whitelist; rename is outside this contract
whitelist.attribution: our independent synthetic lawful semantic counterexample

currentOnly.rule: numeric score >= 0.7 AND source is current-index; preserve id, duplicates and input order
currentOnly.scopeReason: source is business-significant; source perturbation is outside this contract
currentOnly.attribution: our independent synthetic lawful semantic counterexample
